To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the performance of high-throughput scRNaseq data processing pipelines is highly dependent on the sequencing platform, and that the pipelines developed for one platform cannot be directly used on another.

we have developed a framework to compare different high-throughput single-cell RNA sequencing data processing pipelines, and we have found that the pipelines are not equally efficient, robust and accurate.

we have developed a framework to encapsulate seven high-throughput sc RNA-seq data processing piplines with Nextflow, and evaluated their performance on nine public datasets generated by five different high-through-put scRNA-seqs platforms.

the development of a Nextflow-based high-throughput sc RNA-seq data processing pipeline, and the evaluation of its performance on nine real datasets.

the comparison of high-throughput sc-RNA-seq data processing pipeline performance.
